name: Shanghai Trendzone Holdings Group Co.,Ltd
summary: Shanghai Trendzone Holdings Group Co.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, provides integrated solutions across design, construction, production, and services in China and internationally. The company offers consulting; urban development and renewal solutions; one-stop headquarters technology park construction; innovation ecosystem planning; smart construction platform; green and sustainable development; full lifecycle management; and city information modeling (cim) platform integration. It also provides smart wellness and elderly care, smart living environment design and renovation; health monitoring and management system; personalized care; and smart health and wellness community construction, as well as high-end residences, affordable housing, cultural and artistic real estate, office real estate, real estate supporting the event, high-end hotels and commercial complexes, green buildings and senior living communities, intelligent exhibition center, shared communities and talent apartments, prefabricated interior space, educational real estate, medical real estate, and tourism real estate; and Villas. In addition, the company engages in the manufacture and installation of cabinets; sale of fashionable, technological, and environmentally friendly materials; architectural design and construction; decoration of buildings; curtain wall engineering; technology development; software development and equipment installation; and building technology services. Shanghai Trendzone Holdings Group Co.,Ltd was founded in 1998 and is based in Shanghai, China.
